methodology.selection: All six inputs/results/*.parquet files present in the local snapshot.
methodology.metric: Mean of stored boolean correct column; count stored has_boxed independently.
methodology.scoring_in_current_notebook: Extract boxed answer first, fallback final-answer patterns, numbers or last line; compare to answer using verify (binary strings exact, numeric tolerance, otherwise case-insensitive string match). Symbolic task uses symbolic-string matching.
methodology.overlap_check: Match symbolic problem_id strings against id column of inputs/data/v2/train.csv.
methodology.timestamps: Filesystem modification times are provenance hints, not verified training-run dates.

caveats: All 823 symbolic problem IDs in every saved result are in the public competition training CSV. These are local diagnostics, not held-out generalization or leaderboard scores.
Each result has 829 rows: 823 symbolic puzzles plus only one row from each of six other categories. The 829-row aggregate is not a representative overall score.

The best saved symbolic diagnostic is 29/823 (3.523694%) in the file labeled 400 steps; the later-modified 250-step file has 1/823 (0.121507%). Neither is a verified final score for the latest generator.
Result file names identify experiments but are not sufficient to prove the exact training schedule, adapter provenance, or a controlled curriculum comparison.
All saved model results predate the June 14–15 generator-v2 edits. No saved model evaluation of the final v2 generator changes was found.
Low boxed-answer completion is observed. No finish_reason or exact generated-token-count column was saved, so truncation as the causal explanation is unproven.

The ~0.86 baseline is reported in project specifications and baseline notebook names; it is not a measured score of the symbolic curriculum experiment or a new independently verified leaderboard result.
Solver solution coverage uses a different setup from model generation and must not be plotted as a directly comparable LLM accuracy baseline.
